title: The tattoo
summary: You get your first tattoo, your mum's name and a date, and it's spelt wrong. You have to show her. A season on, the tattoo artist wants a photo for his window.

ends.title: Spelt wrong
ends.text: Your first tattoo is your mum's name, spelt wrong. She loves it. She shows people.

ends.title: Covered
ends.text: Your first tattoo was spelt wrong. There's a rose over it now. Your mum still knows what's under there.

beats.title: The tattoo

event.title: The tattoo
event.speaker: mum
setup: Your first tattoo: your mum's name and the day you signed, on the inside of your arm. It's healing. It's also missing a letter. You noticed in the car.

say: {mum.short} has come round with a lasagne. "Go on, then. Your brother says you've had something done."

replies.label: Keep your sleeve down. "It's nothing, Mum."
"Before I show you: it's spelt wrong."

show.text: She reads it. She reads it again. She sits down on the arm of the sofa and laughs until she cries. Then she takes a photo for your nan.

hide.text: "Nothing." She pulls your sleeve up herself, like you're six. "Oh, love."

warn.text: "How wrong?" You show her. "That's very wrong." She's delighted.

beats.hint: You've got something to show Mum

beats.title: Sunday lunch

event.title: Sunday lunch
event.speaker: mum
setup: Sunday lunch at your mum's, and your auntie is there. "Go on," says your mum. "Show her." Your sleeve is down.

say: Your mum is smiling the smile she uses at the doctor's.

show.text: Your auntie reads it out loud, spelling and all. Your mum laughs till she has to sit down.

plaster.text: Your mum knows. She passes you the gravy without a word.

joke.text: Your auntie says that's what your uncle said about his.

beats.hint: Your mum wants to see the tattoo again

beats.title: The window

event.title: The window
event.speaker: mum
setup: A season on, the tattoo artist texts. He wants a photo of your arm for his window. "Famous client. I'll fix the spelling for free first, obviously." Your mum sends a text a minute later: "Don't you dare fix it."
{if arc.deep=='show'}Your auntie still calls you by the wrong spelling.{/if}

outcomes.text: It goes in his window, spelt wrong. Your mum goes past it on the bus twice a week and tells whoever's next to her.

choices.label: Have a rose done over it.

outcomes.text: A rose, very good. Your mum looks at it and says, "I know what's under there," every time.
